subject: Request: Rolling Credit Corridor and VAT validation for NordicHealth pilot
messages:
From: Lena Svensson <lena@NordicHealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>; procure@nordichealth.com
Date: Mon, 2 Aug 2027 09:12:00 +0200
Subject: Credit terms for pilot and VAT docs

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the demo last week — NordicHealth is excited about the latency numbers and the canary rollback behavior. Procurement asked me to loop back on payment terms so we can get a PO in place.

Can Redwood accept Net60 for the initial 6-month pilot? We expect monthly invoicing but our AP cycles are Net60 because of centralized treasury. We can provide VAT registration for our Swedish entity and a signed PO, but procurement will be unable to wire payment earlier than Net60.

Two asks:
- Is Redwood willing to open a rolling credit corridor (capped at $75k) for the pilot with monthly invoicing?
- What VAT evidence do you need from us to avoid gross-up or tax withholding in the EU?

I've attached the procurement template and the VAT certificate we have. Happy to jump on a quick call if useful.

Best,
Lena Svensson
CFO, NordicHealth AB

Attachments: NordicHealth-procurement-template.pdf (procurement template), VAT-Certificate-SWE.pdf (VAT registration)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Lena Svensson <lena@NordicHealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 2 Aug 2027 11:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Credit terms for pilot and VAT docs

Hi Lena — thanks for the clear ask and the docs. We can definitely support a Net60 cadence for invoicing for the pilot subject to a short credit process. Quick notes:

- Rolling credit corridor: we can offer a $75k cap to start with Net60 invoicing, with a monthly review and a provision for a one-time top-up if you hit >85% utilization of the cap.
- Security for the corridor: Redwood typically requires either a PO on file + finance approval or an initial nominal credit holdback (e.g., first invoice on Net30 with the remainder on Net60) depending on credit assessment.
- VAT evidence: our finance team needs a copy of the local VAT registration plus a company registration number for EU tax treaty checks. We also ask for a statement of which legal entity will be billed (e.g., NordicHealth AB) to avoid invoicing the wrong entity and triggering withholding.

I've looped in Monica (Finance Ops) and Marcus (SE) to vet the schedule and technical acceptance criteria. Monica — can you confirm what documentation we need to finalize the billing terms and whether we prefer PO+Net60 or the nominal first-invoice Net30 pattern? Marcus — any downstream impact on meter start or trial milestone billing we should be aware of?

Lena — once finance confirms, I'll send a short terms addendum (one page) that we can sign alongside the PO.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Proposed-PO-schedule.xlsx (proposed invoicing cadence)

From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>; Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lena Svensson <lena@NordicHealth.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Aug 2027 08:42:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Credit terms for pilot and VAT docs

Karthik — thanks for the context. Quick finance take:

- We can accept Net60 for the pilot under a rolling credit corridor capped at $75k, with the following conditions:
  * Signed PO covering monthly invoices and a Redwood one-page credit addendum (I can draft).
  * VAT evidence required: official Swedish VAT registration extract (Skatteverket confirmation) and the company registration number (Org.nr). If NordicHealth invoices to a non-Swedish entity, we need the equivalent VAT proof for that entity.
  * Initial rule: first month invoice to be payable Net30 as a smoke-test of payment; subsequent invoices Net60. If payment history is clean after two invoices, we remove the Net30 step going forward.
  * Payment methods accepted: SEPA (preferred) or wire; ACH is not applicable for EU entities.
  * We will run a quick credit check (trade references + financials) — this is standard and typically completes within 3 business days.

- Related to the credit cap: we'll include an automatic utilization alert at 85% and require two-party sign-off for any bump above the $75k cap.

Marcus — please confirm whether staged metric thresholds are required before we start monthly invoicing (e.g., SLO verification, pilot acceptance sign-off). Lena — if you can confirm which legal entity should receive the invoices and upload the Skatteverket extract to the drive link below, we can get the credit addendum drafted today.

Drive for uploads: https://drive.redwood.com/s/0a1b2c3d/NordicHealth-VAT-Evidence

Regards,
Monica Patel
Finance Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Redwood-Credit-Terms-Draft.pdf (draft of the one-page addendum)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Lena Svensson <lena@NordicHealth.com>; procure@nordichealth.com
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2027 15:48:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Credit terms for pilot and VAT docs

Lena — thanks for the quick turnaround. Confirming next steps and the agreed conditional terms so we have alignment on PO and invoicing: 

1) Redwood will provision a rolling credit corridor capped at $75,000 for the 6-month pilot. Monthly invoices will be issued and, after acceptance of the first invoice, subsequent invoices will be Net60 per the agreed cadence.

2) Payment gate: first invoice payable Net30 (smoke-test). If the first two invoices clear on schedule, Redwood will convert to Net60 for the remainder of the pilot without additional holdback.

3) VAT evidence required before go-live: official Skatteverket VAT extract (Org.nr) uploaded to the secure drive link and confirmation of the legal invoicing entity. This avoids gross-up and ensures zero withholdings.

4) Accepted payment rails for Nordic entities: SEPA credit transfer (IBAN) or wire. Please include your preferred IBAN on the PO.

5) Credit review: Redwood will run a modest credit check (trade refs + public filings). If utilization reaches 85% of the $75k cap, both parties must approve any increase before we raise the limit.

Action items:
- Lena / Procurement: upload VAT extract and return signed PO + indicate IBAN for SEPA — due EOD Wed, Aug 11.
- Monica: draft the one-page credit addendum and send to Karthik for signature.
- Marcus: confirm milestone acceptance events that trigger full production invoicing (if any).

I'll attach the one-page addendum and the proposed PO schedule for your records. Happy to get on a short call if anything needs clarifying.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood-Credit-Terms-Draft.pdf, Proposed-PO-schedule.xlsx
